note: Easing names are Reanimated Easing; durations in ms

step2_recording.name: Screen entry (all screens)
step2_recording.what: On navigation push, content fades in and rises slightly: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 8 to 0.

step2_recording.name: Record button halo (instruction)
step2_recording.what: Loops while the screen is idle: a soft ring behind the button breathes, opacity 0.45 to 0.85 and scale 1 to 1.06. Stops once the button is pressed.
step2_recording.rm: No loop. Static halo at opacity 0.7.

step2_recording.name: Button press
step2_recording.what: Press in: the button scales to 0.96. Release: back to 1. Applies to every Pressable.
step2_recording.rm: Opacity dips to 0.8 instead of scale.

step2_recording.name: Start to countdown
step2_recording.what: Tap Start. The instruction content cross-fades to the countdown: opacity 1 to 0, then the next screen 0 to 1.

step2_recording.name: Countdown ring (3-2-1 only)
step2_recording.what: One shared progress value goes 0 to 1. Each of the 60 ticks changes from the primary color to the track color as progress passes it, clockwise from the top. This is the only countdown in the app.
step2_recording.rm: Ring stays full. Only the number changes.

step2_recording.name: Countdown number
step2_recording.what: Each second the number changes (3, 2, 1), then "Go" holds briefly. The new number fades up: opacity 0.2 to 1, scale 0.9 to 1. The microphone opens about 0.5 s before "Go" with no visual change.

step2_recording.name: Countdown to recording
step2_recording.what: After "Go" the ring fades out (opacity 1 to 0) while the waveform stage fades in. A single light haptic marks the start.

step2_recording.name: Live waveform
step2_recording.what: Audio metering arrives about 20 times a second and is normalised to 0 to 1. Every bar height follows that value, multiplied by a fixed center-weighted shape so the middle bars move most. Rising is quick, falling is slower, so it looks calm and never jittery. For syllable tasks the bars simply pulse with each "pa".
step2_recording.rm: Bars stay at a fixed height. A text line reads "Voice level: good, low or high" and changes at most once a second with a 150 ms fade.

step2_recording.name: Count-up timer
step2_recording.what: Text only: shows 0.0 s counting up in tenths. No animation, no ring, no end point. Tabular numerals keep the digits steady.
step2_recording.rm: Updates once a second, in whole seconds.

step2_recording.name: "Keep going" cue
step2_recording.what: Vowels: "Steady and easy. Keep going." until 5 s, then it cross-fades to "Good. Stop whenever you are ready." Syllables: "Fast and even. Keep going." If the voice level drops for 1 s the cue fades up. It breathes gently: opacity 0.7 to 1.

step2_recording.name: Auto-stop (silence or 30 s cap)
step2_recording.what: After 1.5 s of silence, or at the 30 s cap, the bars settle to their lowest height and the cue fades out. Then a short hold before the next screen. Nothing warns of the cap. Tapping Stop does the same.
step2_recording.rm: Bars set to lowest height at once. Hold stays.

step2_recording.name: Coach card (quiet, loud, noisy, short)
step2_recording.what: After the hold the card and its two illustration rows fade in and rise: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 12 to 0. The "Your recording" bars then grow up from their baseline, one after another, left to right. Buttons are visible from the start, so no one waits to continue.
step2_recording.dur: 350 ms card, 600 ms bars, 12 ms stagger
step2_recording.rm: Card fades in 200 ms. Bars appear at full height, no stagger.

step2_recording.name: Too short is a soft prompt
step2_recording.what: First short try shows two equal buttons: "Use this recording" and "Try again". After the second short try the screen leads with "Use this recording" and "Try once more" is a text link. No timer, no auto-advance, nothing is blocked.

step2_recording.name: Record again
step2_recording.what: One tap. Press feedback, cross-fade to a fresh 3-2-1 countdown. The task segment stays outlined.

step2_recording.name: Task accepted
step2_recording.what: When a recording is accepted (passes the checks or "Use this recording") the current outlined segment fills solid, holds, then the next task’s instruction screen enters. A light success haptic plays. No check mark burst, no celebration.
step2_recording.dur: 400 ms fill, 300 ms hold, 300 ms enter

step3_account_and_consent.name: Screen change
step3_account_and_consent.what: On navigation push the new screen fades in and rises slightly: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 8 to 0. Going back reverses it.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Button press
step3_account_and_consent.what: Press in: scale to 0.96. Release: back to 1. Applies to every Pressable.
step3_account_and_consent.rm: Opacity dips to 0.8 instead of scale.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Field focus
step3_account_and_consent.what: When a field gains focus its border grows from 2 pt to 3 pt and its color changes from the border color to the focus color. The border width change is a layout shift of 1 pt, so animate the color and swap the width.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Show or hide password
step3_account_and_consent.what: Tap Show. The dots swap to the typed text and the button label swaps to "Hide". The text cross-fades.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Login error appears
step3_account_and_consent.what: After a failed log in, the message box grows from height 0 to its measured height while fading in: height 0 to auto, opacity 0 to 1. The password border moves to 3 pt in the primary text color. Focus moves to the message so VoiceOver reads it. No shake, no red.
step3_account_and_consent.rm: Message appears at once. Border change is instant.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Error clears
step3_account_and_consent.what: When the person edits either field the message collapses: height auto to 0, opacity 1 to 0.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Checkbox
step3_account_and_consent.what: Tap to check: the box fills with the primary color and the check mark scales 0.6 to 1 while fading in. Unchecking reverses it.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Continue button enables
step3_account_and_consent.what: On the consent screen, once both boxes are checked the grey disabled button cross-fades to the primary button (two stacked layers, opacity 0 to 1). Text color changes with it.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Welcome waveform
step3_account_and_consent.what: Plays once when the screen first appears: each of the 27 bars grows from scaleY 0.4 to 1 while fading in, starting at the center bar and moving outward. Then it stays perfectly still. It is a picture of what the app listens to, not a loop.
step3_account_and_consent.rm: Bars appear with a 200 ms fade, no stagger or scale.

step3_account_and_consent.name: Reset link sent
step3_account_and_consent.what: The check circle fades in and scales 0.9 to 1, then the heading and text fade in after it.
step3_account_and_consent.dur: 300 ms circle, 200 ms text, 100 ms gap

step3_account_and_consent.name: Keyboard opens
step3_account_and_consent.what: The flexible empty space above the primary button shrinks so the button stays above the keyboard. The content area scrolls the focused field into view.
step3_account_and_consent.rm: Same. This follows the keyboard, not a decorative animation.

step4_result_and_home.name: Result reveal: band
step4_result_and_home.what: About 0.3 s after the screen appears, the band card and the Low, Borderline, Elevated scale fade in together: opacity 0 to 1. Nothing else moves. No scale, no slide.

step4_result_and_home.name: Result reveal: explanation
step4_result_and_home.what: The "What this means" text fades in after the band has settled: opacity 0 to 1, starting 1400 ms after the band began.

step4_result_and_home.name: Result reveal: next step
step4_result_and_home.what: The "Your next step" card fades in last, starting 2400 ms after the band began. Total reveal takes about 3 seconds.

step4_result_and_home.name: Always visible
step4_result_and_home.what: The line "This is a screening, not a diagnosis." and the "Save a summary for my doctor" button are present from the first frame and never animate. No confetti, sound or haptic on any band.

step4_result_and_home.name: Screen reader
step4_result_and_home.what: When the screen appears, VoiceOver focus goes to the band card and reads "Your result: Borderline. We noticed some patterns..." in full, without waiting for the fade.

step4_result_and_home.name: Home entry
step4_result_and_home.what: On first load the screen fades in with the usual push: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 8 to 0.

step4_result_and_home.name: First-time waveform (home)
step4_result_and_home.what: The waveform picture in the empty state fades in once and then stays still.

step4_result_and_home.name: Tab change
step4_result_and_home.what: The content cross-fades and the 4 pt underline under the tab label changes color. The underline does not slide.

step4_result_and_home.name: Row and card press
step4_result_and_home.what: The latest-result card and each earlier-check row dim slightly on press: opacity 1 to 0.85, back on release.
step4_result_and_home.rm: Same, it is a color-only change.

step4_result_and_home.name: Start button
step4_result_and_home.what: Press in: scale to 0.96. Release: back to 1. Then the normal push to the instruction screen.
step4_result_and_home.rm: Opacity dips to 0.8 instead of scale.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Past result opens
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: Opened from the Results list. The band, scale, meaning and next step are shown at once with no reveal, because the person has already seen it. The screen pushes in like any other: opacity 0 to 1, translateX 12 to 0.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Results list row press
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The row dims on press: opacity 1 to 0.85, back on release. No other movement.
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.rm: Same, it is a color-only change.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Learn topic open
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: Tapping a topic card pushes the article in: opacity 0 to 1, translateX 12 to 0. Cards dim on press like list rows.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Appearance control
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: Choosing iPhone, Light or Dark changes the selected fill color. The whole app cross-fades to the new theme once.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Delete dialog
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The scrim fades from 0 to 55% black and the dialog fades in at the same time. No slide, no bounce. Focus moves to the dialog title. The safe button, Keep my recordings, is the primary one.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Delete dialog closes
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The scrim and dialog fade out together, then the list re-appears unchanged.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Looking at your recordings
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The microphone circle has a soft halo that slowly grows and shrinks: scale 1 to 1.06 and back, opacity 1 to 0.7 and back. The eight segments stay filled. Nothing says how long it will take beyond "a few seconds".
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.rm: Halo stays still. The text alone shows that it is working.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Ready, then result
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The check mark circle and text fade in once: opacity 0 to 1. Pressing See my result goes to the result screen and its slow reveal.

step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.name: Save summary (PDF)
step5_past_result_learn_settings_finish.what: The button label changes to "Preparing…" with no spinner, then the iPhone share sheet opens. The PDF page itself is a still document.
